rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for an option, a selection, or the result of deciding.

example.english: This restaurant has a lot of choice.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 syun2 zaak6 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this specifically for the power or right to make a choice.

example.english: You have the choice to refuse.
example.traditional: 你有選擇權，可以唔接受。
example.jyutping: nei5 jau5 syun2 zaak6 kyun4 ho2 ji5 m4 zip3 sau6
